about.en: Zentry, formerly GuildFi, is a project that started as a cross-game social and rewards layer for gamers and now describes itself as a Human-Agentic OS that turns user activity into data and AI products. ZENT is its governance and ecosystem token, an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xdbb7a34bf10169d6d2d0d02a6cbb436cf4381bfa with deployments on BNB Chain, Base and Ronin.
